guitar.evidence: Trained knowledge: Bernard Sumner used a Gibson SG and Vox Phantom guitar in Joy Division, well documented among post-punk gear enthusiasts.

tone.target: pulsing post-punk bassline guitar with dry chorusy edge and slight flange
tone.profile: pulsing post-punk bassline guitar with dry chorusy edge and slight flange
tone.summary: A tight, chorus-driven signal chain using a clean pre-amp and US Deluxe/Silver Twin emulation with Chorus and light compression to achieve the pulsing, dry sound of 'Transmission'.
corrections: make modulation more obvious than ambience

blocks.purpose: Clean up any hum or unwanted noise from the electric guitar.
Add sustain and even out the dynamics for a tight, repetitive pulse.
blocks.gap: The Comp module is ideal for adding rhythmic consistency without sounding overly processed.

blocks.purpose: Provide a subtle, clean-to-light grit and edge without heavy distortion.
blocks.gap: The Green OD offers the necessary breakup character for post-punk tones while remaining relatively transparent.

blocks.purpose: Create the required chorusy movement and subtle flange effect.
Emulate a clean, bright American tone suitable for rhythmic bass lines.
blocks.gap: The US Deluxe provides the necessary clarity and punch without excessive coloration.

blocks.purpose: Provide a focused, dry, and articulate cabinet sound.
blocks.gap: The US 2x12 is excellent for capturing the tight, punchy character needed for this genre.

blocks.purpose: Tuck the low end slightly and boost the upper mids to ensure definition and cut through the mix.
blocks.gap: Used for surgical EQ adjustments, focusing on clarity over warmth.

blocks.purpose: Add minimal, natural ambience (room tone) without sounding like deep reverb.

proposals.reason: Enhance clarity and punch for rhythmic bass lines.
